0.text: Nine out of ten business texts get opened.

1.text: The average customer reads a business text within 90 seconds of receiving it.
That window is faster than any other marketing channel.
At the cost of a text message, nothing else even comes close.

2.text: SMS reaches 98 percent of customers who receive it.
Facebook organic posts reach about 5 percent of your followers.
Text is not just another channel.
It is the one that actually reaches people.

3.text: Text messages get a 45 percent response rate compared to 6 percent for email.
For every 100 customers you reach, nearly half respond.
No other channel at this price point comes close to that kind of engagement.

4.text: Before you send a single marketing text, you need explicit written consent.
The Telephone Consumer Protection Act requires it.
Fines run up to $1,500 per message for violations.
Getting opt-in right is the foundation the whole system sits on.

5.text: A checkbox at checkout with clear disclosure language.
A keyword opt-in where the customer texts a word to your number.
Or a paper sign-up sheet at the counter for service businesses where the customer is on-site.

6.text: The first message goes out same day or next morning.
Just a direct line back to a real person.
This message generates replies 20 to 30 percent of the time.
Every reply is a chance to solve a problem before it becomes a negative review.

7.text: Message two fires on day three or four with a specific offer.
Ten percent off your next visit works.
Give them a concrete reason with a loose deadline.

8.text: The third message fires at day 28 to 30.
A customer who had a good experience a month ago and has not been contacted since is far more likely to rebook.
You are reminding someone who already chose you.

9.text: Opt-out rates stay below 2 percent when businesses send four or fewer texts per month.
The 3-message sequence keeps you well within that range.
More than that and opt-out rates climb fast, damaging your list permanently.

10.text: SimpleTexting starts at $29 a month for 500 texts.
Write three message templates once and they run automatically after every new opt-in.
The only manual work is replying to the conversations they start.
